{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ooe'b Towers''' were a group of buildings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The towers were made of [[mirrsteel]] and stood as tall as [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] from the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They were joined by a number of pedestrian bridges which reminded the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] of the mazes down in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|shadowlands]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] planet. Found near the [[Sasal Center]] and the [[Wauth Complex]], they were visible from [[Chewbacca's quarters]].
